name: LACY GTA VI Marathon (Reach, $12.5K pool)
visualRules: Logos of any kind are not allowed: no console, app, store, brand, game-tile or radio-station logos, and no watermarks. GTA 6's own world (signs, cars, storefronts) is fine.
Lacy must be the primary focus: footage that is mostly someone else's stream or video doesn't count.
notes: Source: Lacy's GTA 6 marathon (from Nov 18, 2026). Lacy must be the primary focus of every clip: his reaction, his voice or his gameplay carries the moment, not chat, a guest or another streamer. Never portray Lacy in a negative light, never hate-farm, never imply drama or a false story; hooks must be positive or neutral and true to what happens. Prefer GTA 6 moments: first reactions to the game, chases, crashes, funny NPC moments, giveaway moments, big laughs. English only. The hook and caption must name LACY.
